title: We depend on a single manufacturing facility
body: All of our output comes from one plant. A fire or long outage would stop sales.
simple: One factory makes everything the company sells. If it shuts down for long, sales stop.

title: We have incurred losses in recent years
body: We reported net losses in each of the last three fiscal years and may not become profitable.
simple: The company lost money in each of the last three years and may keep losing money.

title: Our licences may not be renewed
body: Our operations need licences that are renewed periodically; renewal is not assured.
simple: The company needs licences to operate. They must be renewed, and renewal is not guaranteed.

title: A few customers account for most of our revenue
body: Our top five customers contributed 71% of revenue from operations.
simple: Five customers bring in 71% of revenue. Losing one would hurt.

title: We are party to legal proceedings
body: Outstanding proceedings against us involve an aggregate amount of ₹ 120 million.
simple: The company faces court cases involving about ₹ 120 million in total.

title: Our promoters will keep control after the offer
body: After the Offer our promoters will hold 58% and can influence shareholder votes.
simple: The promoters will still own 58% and can sway most shareholder decisions.

title: The offer price may not reflect the market value
body: The price was set by book building and may differ from the price at which shares trade.
simple: The offer price is set by bidding; the share may later trade at a very different price.

title: We depend on key managerial personnel
body: Our senior management team has been with us for years and is hard to replace.
simple: A few senior people run the business and would be hard to replace.
